summary: Recovery of two missing hikers in the Mount Goliath area
notes: Annual log marks entry as a follow-up and a significant mission; second source URL is Alpine's individual mission post (opened in search results). Merge run 441: 5280 feature (opened) identifies the pair as Damian McManus, 51, and his son Evan, 18, of Minnesota — went to climb a peak April 2, 2014, reported missing April 6; search suspended after four days when a snowstorm obliterated tracks; bodies found in July (Alpine Rescue Team search).
